name: Ela (son of Baasha)
title: Fourth king of Israel
summary: Ela was the fourth king of the northern kingdom of Israel and the son of King Baasha. He reigned for only two years before being killed by his servant Zimri during a drinking feast in Tirzah. His short and unremarkable reign marked the end of Baasha's dynasty.

keyEvents.title: Ela becomes king over Israel
keyEvents.description: Ela succeeded his father Baasha as king over Israel in the twenty-seventh year of Asa's reign over Judah. He reigned from Tirzah.

keyEvents.title: Zimri's conspiracy
keyEvents.description: Zimri, who was commander of half the chariots, conspired against Ela while the king was getting drunk in the house of Arza, the palace administrator at Tirzah.

keyEvents.title: Ela's death
keyEvents.description: Zimri struck Ela down and took the throne for himself. This happened in the twenty-seventh year of Asa's reign over Judah, after only two years of Ela's rule.

keyEvents.title: Fulfillment of the Prophecy Against Baasha's House
keyEvents.description: Zimri destroyed all of Baasha's house, just as the prophet Jehu had prophesied. This happened because of all the sins that Baasha and his son Elah had committed.
